docs: Content of the Others page and its folders. others.html shows one card per section (no names inside); each section's own page (pagina) lists its items with a live preview. To add a page or a game, add an item to the right section: titulo, href (relative to the site root), texto, and optional etiquetas and nota. unidade: singular and plural for the count.

seccoes.resumo: Natural intelligence projects, built to last.

itens.texto: A natural intelligence, deployed in January 2025: live uptime, the next release, growth metrics and the changelog.
Shy fish swim to a lullaby. Touch the screen and they hide and the music stops; wait calmly and they come back one by one, bringing the music with them.
